tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and terminal background. The ground every other token is checked against.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels set off from the page: tool output, code blocks, the permission box.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The prompt input bar, hovered rows, pressed secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and decorative frames. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, secondary buttons). At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text, the green on black. Reads on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and emphasised text on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, hints, line numbers, tool output summaries. 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: claude
tokens.usage: Orange. Claude's own voice: the assistant bullet, the brand, primary actions and the cursor. Text on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-claude
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a claude fill (primary buttons).

tokens.name: claude-tint
tokens.usage: Faint orange ground behind a selected row or the active option. claude and fg read on it.

tokens.name: prompt
tokens.usage: The person's input: the > caret and their typed message. Text on bg and surface-raised.

tokens.name: tool
tokens.usage: Cyan. Tool calls: Bash, Read, Edit, Grep and their names. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: tool-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a tool badge. tool reads on it.

tokens.name: path
tokens.usage: Blue. File paths, URLs and links, always underlined when interactive. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: think
tokens.usage: Violet. Thinking, planning and other meta activity that is not output. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success and added lines (+). Always paired with a glyph (✓ or +). Text on bg, surface and ok-tint.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of added diff lines and success badges.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Errors, denials and removed lines (-). Always paired with a glyph (✗ or -). Text on bg, surface and err-tint.

tokens.name: err-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of removed diff lines and error badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Yellow. Waiting on the person: permission requests, destructive commands, rate limits. Text on bg, surface and warn-tint.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the permission box and warning badges.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Orange so it is never confused with a status colour.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Brand name and splash screens only. One per screen.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Tool call headers, section headings inside a transcript.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: I'll run the tests first to see what fails.
styles.usage: Transcript messages and prompt input. 15px so it stays readable on a phone without zoom.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Code blocks, diffs and tool output.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, the status line, hints.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Uppercase badges and field labels. Never running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its text, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, padding inside code lines and list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones, panel padding on desktop, gap between transcript turns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; side gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations: top of a screen, around the splash.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Transcript rows, diff lines, the status line: a terminal has square cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and buttons: just enough to soften on high-density screens.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels: code blocks, the permission box, the prompt bar.

size.note: Touch sizes. The terminal look stays dense, but anything tappable meets the 44px target.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control on the web: buttons, options, toggles, rows, tabs.

tokens.name: touch-android
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control on Android (48dp): the 44px minimum rounded up to the platform guideline.

tokens.name: prompt-height
tokens.usage: Height of the docked prompt bar on phones.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum transcript width on wide screens, about a classic wide terminal.
